judgment_text:
ORDER

This application has been filed under Section 9 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, seeking to raise the prohibitory order passed in Arbitration Application No. 605 of 2025 dated 3-6-2025.

2. The learned counsel for applicant brought to the notice of this Court that subsequently, the loan amount was regularized and hence, the present application has been filed to raise the prohibitory order passed in Arbitration Application No. 605 of 2025 dated 3-6-2025. The learned counsel further submitted that if, in case, the respondents again commit default, liberty must be granted to the applicant to approach this Court.

3. In the light of the above submission made, the prohibitory order made by this Court in Arbitration Application No. 605 of 2025 dated 3-6-2025 is recalled/raised. If, in the event the respondent committing any default in future, it is left open to the applicant to approach this Court and seek necessary relief.

Accordingly, this application is disposed of.
